The <c:ffff00>{{medal}}<c>'s overall strength: the total of its <c:ffff00>skill<c>
<c:ffff00>levels<c>, which rise as you use <c:ffff00>actions<c> in <c:ffff00>{{robattle}}<c> up
to the current <c:ffff00>{{activity_level}}<c> (max 150).
1/3 of the {{medal_level}} becomes the <c:ffff00>{{level_bonus}}<c>,
which raises all skill levels, even untrained ones.
A high level speeds up the <c:ffff00>{{prep}}<c> and <c:ffff00>{{cooldown}}<c> of
<c:ffff00>{{medaforce}}<c> and <c:ffff00>{{medachange}}<c> and, depending on the
{{opponent}}, raises <c:ffff00>{{defend}}<c> and <c:ffff00>{{evade}}<c> too. It also
changes the <c:ffff00>{{rank}}<c> ({{silver}}, {{gold}}).
